source: BLS Producer Price Index (NAICS industry classification), API v1
known_limitations: 22 clusters; analytic cluster-robust p-values over-reject and a wild cluster bootstrap is reported alongside.
Agriculture and forestry (BEA 111CA, 113FF) have no NAICS-industry PPI and are absent from the estimation panel entirely.
Composite BEA industries average component PPI series unweighted, because NAICS-component output weights are not available in the BEA summary tables.
PPI industry indices cover an entire NAICS group while exposure is built from 10-digit lines; the aggregation gap attenuates any true relationship.
